audit.why: Pantheon owns levels 1-5 and the first-item window; Sejuani only levels the lane at 6 and takes over at two items. Chart matches.
Spikes at Pantheon 1-3, Sejuani 6 (Glacial Prison), Sunfire, and two items are right; the level-6 spike is now tied to a real interaction rather than to a shield that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text refers seven times to 'Pantheon's passive shield'. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will, which empowers his next spell every few spells or attacks — it is not a shield. The shield is Aegis Assault (E), and Riot's description says it makes him invulnerable to damage from the front, not all round. Separately: Aegis Assault is a channel that Permafrost and Glacial Prison cancel; Shield Vault carries an auto-attack reset; and Sejuani's resistances are again called 'Permafrost armor' when they are Fury of the North's Frost Armor.
audit.why: A whole fabricated defensive mechanic drives the advice ('trade when his passive shield is on cooldown'), and the real, decisive one — cancelling a 22-second channel — is nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will named for what it does; Aegis Assault named as the shield, front-only, and cancellable by your CC; Shield Vault's auto reset stated as the tell; Frost Armor named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: No seconds anywhere; dosFull[2].d calls Shield Vault a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 and Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18 — the E is the real punishable gap.
audit.corrected: Real numbers used; the fifteen-second figure corrected to thirteen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault's channel and its front-only damage block were absent.
audit.why: They decide both how you punish him and where you stand in a side-lane duel.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[1], wants.you[0], mid and late.

edits.before: Pantheon wins levels 1 through 3 cleanly — his passive shield eats your first auto, his Q poke chips your Permafrost armor off before you can stack Frost, and his W point-click stun fires before your E can stun him back. Do not try to trade level 1; walk up only to last-hit and let him push. At level 2 he gets W and you get Q — if he stuns you into a wall or under tower he can kill you, so never stand near terrain. Level 3 is the first time you have Q-W-E available, but his full combo still out-damages yours at this HP level; take short trades only when his W stun is confirmed on cooldown and get out with Q.
edits.after: Pantheon wins levels 1 through 3 cleanly — Mortal Will empowers every few casts, his Comet Spear poke breaks Frost Armor before you can stack Frost, and his W point-click stun fires before your E can stun him back. Do not try to trade level 1; walk up only to last-hit and let him push. At level 2 he gets Shield Vault and you get Q — it is a dash-stun carrying an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Level 3 is the first time you have Q-W-E available, but his combo still out-damages yours at this HP level; trade only once Shield Vault's 13 seconds are confirmed spent, and leave with Q.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a neutral window — Pantheon's all-in damage peaks here but he cannot one-shot you if you kept Permafrost armor stacked by avoiding poke. Keep the wave even or slightly in your favor so he cannot freeze and punish your walk-up. Level 6 flips the threat dynamic: Glacial Prison travels far enough to catch him before Grand Starfall lands, and a successful R stun into Q-W-E can kill him or force flash. Track his R animation — the moment he commits to a roam, either match with your own R or force a tower dive trade he cannot answer. His passive shield matters less and less as your resistance stacking compounds.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are a neutral window — Pantheon's all-in damage peaks here but he cannot one-shot you if Frost Armor survived his poke, so walk up between Comet Spears rather than through them. Keep the wave even or slightly in your favor so he cannot freeze and punish your walk-up. Level 6 flips the threat dynamic: Aegis Assault is a channel and Permafrost or Glacial Prison cancels it outright, so the moment he plants that shield you stun rather than back off — 22 seconds at rank 1 is the longest gap in his kit. Track his R too: the moment he commits to a roam, either match it with your own or force the tower trade he cannot answer.

edits.before: Past first item Pantheon loses the ability to blow you up — his damage line flatlines while your CC chain and tankiness compound with every resistance item. In teamfights your job is to absorb his Grand Starfall with your passive Permafrost armor, then Glacial Prison the primary carry he was diving toward. In side lane you win the 1v1 cleanly: Q to close, W double-strike to apply two Frost stacks, E to stun him in place, and he cannot kill you before the stun expires. Deny him the side-lane roam pattern by keeping him in lane or following his R — late Pantheon lives and dies on his global, and you deny it.
edits.after: Past first item Pantheon loses the ability to blow you up — his damage line flatlines while your CC chain and tankiness compound with every resistance item. In teamfights your job is to absorb his Grand Starfall with Frost Armor, then Glacial Prison the primary carry he was diving toward. In side lane you win the 1v1 cleanly: Q to close, W double-strike for two Frost stacks, E to stun him in place, and if he sets Aegis Assault it blocks damage only from the front — walk behind him instead of feeding it. Deny him the side-lane roam pattern by keeping him in lane or following his R — late Pantheon lives and dies on his global, and you deny it.

edits.before: Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun) on nothing — take the thirteen-second invitation.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - Q dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault: 13s at rank 1, a point-click dash-stun with an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. - Aegis Assault: 22s, a channel your Permafrost or R cancels outright. - Comet Spear: 11s. Step up on the gaps.

notes: The largest defect in this matchup: seven references to a 'Pantheon passive shield'. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will (empowers his next spell every few spells or attacks). The shield is Aegis Assault (E), Riot's own text says invulnerable to damage from the front only, and it is a channel — which is the interaction the page was missing entirely. Sejuani's resistances were again attributed to 'Permafrost armor'; they are Fury of the North's Frost Armor. NOT ASSERTED (left alone, unverifiable from local data): whether Glacial Prison can interrupt Grand Starfall's descent — the existing mid-text claim that R 'travels far enough to catch him before Grand Starfall lands' was replaced with the Aegis Assault cancel, which is verifiable, rather than corrected.
